title: NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit: Size Selection Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: PCR Enrichment](http://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/4b4a80-pcr_enrichment) With this protocol, your robot can perform the NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina E6177S/L protocol described by the [NEBNext E6177S/L](https://www.neb.com/products/e6177-nebnext-ultra-ii-fs-dna-library-prep-with-sample-purification-beads#Product%20Information). [NEB Instruction Manual for NEBNext E6177S/L](https://s3.amazonaws.com./pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-02-16/8q531ae/manualE6177-E7805.pdf). This is part 3 of the protocol: Size Selection This step size-selects and cleans up the sample output from part 2 to obtain a specific insert size range of 350-600 bp. Choose pcr labware compatible with the Opentrons Magnetic Module such as "(Magnetic Module compatible) Nest 96 wellplate 100ul pcr full skirt" using the parameters below. This protocol assumes up to 24 input DNA samples of > 100 ng and follows Section 2 of the NEB Instruction Manual. After the size selection and cleanup steps carried out in this protocol (part 3), proceed with part
With magnets engaged, transfer supernatants to trash.

steps.title: Select compatible PCR plate
steps.instruction: Choose a magnetic‑module‑compatible 96‑well PCR plate (e.g., Nest 100 µL full‑skirt) and place it on the Opentrons magnetic module.

steps.title: Add water and mix
steps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to each sample on the magnetic module until the total volume reaches 100 µL, then mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add first SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Add the first SPRI bead suspension to each sample to achieve a 0.2× right‑side selection ratio and mix well.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to fresh plate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnets, allow beads to pellet, then transfer the cleared supernatant to a fresh 96‑well plate positioned on the OT‑2 deck.

steps.title: Pause for manual plate move
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol: manually remove the plate containing bead pellets and relocate the supernatant plate onto the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add second SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Add the second SPRI bead suspension to each well to reach a 0.375× left‑side selection ratio and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to trash
steps.instruction: With the magnets engaged, allow beads to pellet and then discard the supernatant to waste.

steps.title: Wash beads and elute
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet twice with 80 % ethanol, then elute the DNA and transfer 15 µL of eluate to a fresh 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 % ethanol to the beads, let stand briefly, and remove the ethanol (first wash).
Repeat the ethanol wash a second time.
Add elution buffer, mix, and incubate as recommended, then collect 15 µL eluate into a new plate.
